speaker: xia
name: 小夏
text: 先别给我公式。我把这个小球挪一挪，能看出什么？
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: che
name: 阿澈
text: 红球是源电荷，大Q。金球是试探电荷，小q。看金箭头，力F会改变小球的运动；箭头告诉你往哪儿推、多用力。
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: xia
name: 小夏
text: 那换一个更大的球，就是带电更多？
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: che
name: 阿澈
text: 光看球大小不行。电荷量才表示带电的正负和多少，单位是库仑。这里把球画大，只是为了看清位置。
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: xia
name: 小夏
text: 我保持距离，绕着红球挪。金箭头一直在转，长度倒没变。
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: che
name: 阿澈
text: 看两球连线，力就在这个方向。对这个点电荷，离它一样远，力的大小就一样。不用分上下左右另记几条规则。
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: xia
name: 小夏
text: 拉到两倍远，我猜力会剩一半。只有四分之一？看来猜错了，是距离平方在起作用。
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: che
name: 阿澈
text: 现在固定位置。小q加倍，力也加倍。把小q换成负的，金箭头反过来了。
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: xia
name: 小夏
text: 只换了测量的小球，力就不同。那怎么说清这个位置本身有什么特点？
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: che
name: 阿澈
text: 试着用力F除以电荷量q。几次得到的方向和大小都相同。我们把这个量叫电场强度E，单位是牛顿每库仑。
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: xia
name: 小夏
text: 有点像风向图？先给每个位置标一个箭头，再看放进去的东西会怎样。
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: che
name: 阿澈
text: 借的是这张空间分布图的想法。电场不是吹过来的风。这里受力等于q乘E：只换小q，场不变，力会变。
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: xia
name: 小夏
text: 那换成电子呢？它的q是负的，所以金色力箭头和蓝色电场箭头反着。
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: che
name: 阿澈
text: 再看点源公式。Q是源的电荷量，r是距离。k是库仑常量，确定这组单位下的比例。正源向外，负源向内。
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.

speaker: xia
name: 小夏
text: 我再试一次：同距离换方向，同位置换电荷。看清哪次改变场，哪次只改变力。
word_timing_source: Provider subtitle metadata, adjusted for edge trim and pitch-preserving tempo; not independently forced-aligned.
